title: Cross-domain closure validations — Litigation & Reserves deep check
walkthroughSteps: Apply AC-01 — seeds 2 active litigation cases on CLM-2024-001
Click Close Claim → modal step 1 shows litigation blocker with count + Go to Litigation link
Click Go to Litigation → modal closes, routed to /claims/CLM-2024-001/litigation
Apply AC-02 — seeds open reserves + provider flag on CLM-2024-001
Click Close Claim → modal shows reserves blocker with count + EUR total amount
Observe reserves 'Go to Reserves' is visually disabled (Feature not available — no route yet)
Apply AC-03 — all blockers present simultaneously: 2 litigation + 1 open reserve line + provider flag

acceptanceCriteria.statement: Litigation blocker fires from real service query — shows count + Go to Litigation link
acceptanceCriteria.plainStatement: When **active litigation cases** exist for the claim (status = 'In progress'), the closure modal step 1 shows a blocker listing the **count of active cases** and a **Go to Litigation** button that navigates to the litigation page on click.

setup.description: CLM-2024-001 already has 2 'In progress' litigation entries in mock data — no flag override needed. Tasks + sections must be clear so only litigation blocks closure.

preconditions.text: Close Claim shows litigation blocker with count '2'
'Go to Litigation' link is present in blocker item
Clicking 'Go to Litigation' closes modal and navigates to /claims/CLM-2024-001/litigation

expectedUI.description: Litigation blocker with real count from service query
visualCues: Modal step 1 — blocker label: '2 active litigation case(s) must be resolved'
'Go to Litigation' link rendered as an underlined blue button
Clicking link: modal closes, browser routes to /claims/CLM-2024-001/litigation

howToTest.expectedResult: Modal step 1 shows litigation blocker with count 2 and a Go to Litigation link

acceptanceCriteria.statement: Reserves blocker fires from real service query — shows count + EUR total amount
acceptanceCriteria.plainStatement: When **open reserve lines** exist for the claim's policy (amount > 0), the closure modal step 1 shows a blocker listing the **count of open reserve lines** and the **total reserved amount in EUR**.

setup.description: CLM-2024-001 is linked to POL-2023-010 which has seeded reserve lines in MockReservesService. Tasks + sections cleared, litigation cleared via flag override. Provider flag set to demonstrate a flag-only blocker alongside a deep blocker.

preconditions.text: Reserves blocker shows count and EUR total
Provider blocker shows with 'Feature not available' text (no link)

expectedUI.description: Reserves blocker with count + amount; provider with generic label
visualCues: Modal step 1 — reserves blocker: 'X open reserve line(s) must be released — EUR YY,YYY'
'Go to Reserves' rendered but visually muted/disabled (no route yet)
Provider blocker: 'Provider instructions must be finalised — Feature not available' (italic muted)

howToTest.expectedResult: Modal step 1 shows reserves blocker with line count and total EUR amount

acceptanceCriteria.statement: Multiple cross-domain blockers visible simultaneously — deep + flag-only
acceptanceCriteria.plainStatement: When litigation, reserves, and provider flag are all outstanding, the modal shows **all three blockers** simultaneously — 2 deep (real service query) and 1 flag-only — demonstrating that both check types coexist correctly.

setup.description: Tasks + sections cleared. CLM-2024-001 already has 2 active litigation records in mock data. Reserves are seeded for POL-2023-010. Provider flag set. No hasActiveLitigation override needed — the real service query fires.

preconditions.text: Modal shows 3 blockers: litigation (count 2), reserves (count + amount), provider (flag-only)

expectedUI.description: All three blockers shown; litigation and reserves are enriched with detail
visualCues: Litigation: '2 active litigation case(s) must be resolved — Go to Litigation'
Reserves: 'X open reserve line(s) must be released — EUR YYY,YYY'
Provider: 'Provider instructions must be finalised — Feature not available'

howToTest.trigger: Click Close Claim after applying AC-03 setup
howToTest.expectedResult: 3 blockers visible; 2 deep (with count/amount), 1 flag-only (no link)
